paragraphs.text: 1. WITH thee, O Agni, was this singer of the laud: he hath no other kinship, O thou Son of Strength.
paragraphs.original: अयमग्ने जरिता त्वे अभूदपि सहसः सूनो नह्यन्यदस्त्याप्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ayamagne jaritā tve abhūdapi sahasaḥ sūno nahyanyadastyāpyam |

paragraphs.text: Thou givest blessed shelter with a triple guard. Keep the destructive lightning far away from us.
paragraphs.original: भद्रं हि शर्म त्रिवरूथमस्ति त आरे हिंसानामप दिद्युमा कृधि
paragraphs.translit: bhadraṃ hi śarma trivarūthamasti ta āre hiṃsānāmapa didyumā kṛdhi

paragraphs.text: 2. Thy birth who seekest food is in the falling flood, Agni: as Comrade thou winnest all living things.
paragraphs.original: प्रवत्ते अग्ने जनिमा पितूयतः साचीव विश्वा भुवना न्यृञ्जसे ।
paragraphs.translit: pravatte agne janimā pitūyataḥ sācīva viśvā bhuvanā nyṛñjase |

paragraphs.text: Our coursers and our songs shall be victorious: they of themselves advance like one who guards the herd.
paragraphs.original: प्र सप्तयः प्र सनिषन्त नो धियः पुरश्चरन्ति पशुपा इव त्मना
paragraphs.translit: pra saptayaḥ pra saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ puraścaranti paśupā iva tmanā

paragraphs.text: 3. And thou, O Agni, thou of Godlike nature, sparest the stones, while caring up the brushwood.
paragraphs.original: उत वा उ परि वृणक्षि बप्सद्बहोरग्न उलपस्य स्वधावः ।
paragraphs.translit: uta vā u pari vṛṇakṣi bapsadbahoragna ulapasya svadhāvaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Then are thy tracks like deserts in the corn-lands. Let us not stir to wrath thy mighty arrow.
paragraphs.original: उत खिल्या उर्वराणां भवन्ति मा ते हेतिं तविषीं चुक्रुधाम
paragraphs.translit: uta khilyā urvarāṇāṃ bhavanti mā te hetiṃ taviṣīṃ cukrudhāma

paragraphs.text: 4. O'er hills through vales devouring as thou goest, thou partest like an army fain for booty
paragraphs.original: यदुद्वतो निवतो यासि बप्सत्पृथगेषि प्रगर्धिनीव सेना ।
paragraphs.translit: yadudvato nivato yāsi bapsatpṛthageṣi pragardhinīva senā |

paragraphs.text: As when a barber shaves a beard, thou shavest earth when the wind blows on thy flame and fans it.
paragraphs.original: यदा ते वातो अनुवाति शोचिर्वप्तेव श्मश्रु वपसि प्र भूम
paragraphs.translit: yadā te vāto anuvāti śocirvapteva śmaśru vapasi pra bhūma

paragraphs.text: 5. Apparent are his lines as he approaches the course is single, but the cars are many,
paragraphs.original: प्रत्यस्य श्रेणयो ददृश्र एकं नियानं बहवो रथासः ।
paragraphs.translit: pratyasya śreṇayo dadṛśra ekaṃ niyānaṃ bahavo rathāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: When, Agni, thou, making thine arms resplendent, advancest o'er the land spread out beneath thee.
6. Now let thy strength, thy burning flames fly upward, thine energies, O Agni, as thou toilest.
paragraphs.original: उत्ते शुष्मा जिहतामुत्ते अर्चिरुत्ते अग्ने शशमानस्य वाजाः ।
paragraphs.translit: utte śuṣmā jihatāmutte arcirutte agne śaśamānasya vājāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Gape widely, bend thee, waxing in thy vigour: let all the Vasus sit this day beside thee.
paragraphs.original: उच्छ्वञ्चस्व नि नम वर्धमान आ त्वाद्य विश्वे वसवः सदन्तु
paragraphs.translit: ucchvañcasva ni nama vardhamāna ā tvādya viśve vasavaḥ sadantu

paragraphs.text: 7. This is the waters' reservoir, the great abode of gathered streams.
Take thou another path than this, and as thou listest walk thereon.
paragraphs.original: अन्यं कृणुष्वेतः पन्थां तेन याहि वशाँ अनु
paragraphs.translit: anyaṃ kṛṇuṣvetaḥ panthāṃ tena yāhi vaśām̐ anu

paragraphs.text: 8. On thy way hitherward and hence let flowery Durva grass spring up
paragraphs.original: आयने ते परायणे दूर्वा रोहन्तु पुष्पिणीः ।
paragraphs.translit: āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohantu puṣpiṇīḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let there be lakes with lotus blooms. These are the mansions of the flood.
